employer.name: Tidewater Analytics B.V.
employer.signatory: Femke de Groot, Head of People

place: The Rotterdam office, Wijnhaven 60, 3011 WS Rotterdam

job.title: Data engineer
job.description: Builds and runs the data pipelines for client projects.

term.note: The contract covers the client project it was made for

probation.conditions: either side may end the employment during the probation without notice

training: Two days a year of paid training of the worker's choice, at the employer's cost
leave: 25 working days of paid leave a year, in proportion to the fixed term; leave is requested through the staff portal at least two weeks ahead
termination: Either side ends the employment in writing. The fixed term ends on its end date without notice; before then either side may end it with one calendar month's notice to the end of a month, as the contract allows

pay.method: bank transfer to the worker's account

components.name: Holiday allowance
components.text: 8 percent of the gross yearly salary, paid in May

hours.standard: 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday
hours.overtime: no paid overtime; extra hours are taken back as time off within the month

social_security: The employer withholds and pays the social security contributions to the Dutch Tax Administration and provides a pension through the company pension scheme

abroad.benefits: a daily allowance of EUR 45, with hotel and travel paid by the employer
abroad.repatriation: the employer pays the journey home at the end of the assignment and one trip home every second weekend
